desc: Implement an iterative segment tree over indices with active/inactive leaves and combine total/pref/suff/best using the non-empty max-subarray rules.
Initialize the tree with all elements active, then process only negative values with frequency < n by deactivating all their indices, reading root.best, and reactivating them.
Run the provided examples, edge cases, and brute-force random validation; all tests passed, so no bug fix or approach switch is required.
